name: The old well
words: Two pins in one station; a tap on a pin opens its description, which travels between the pin and the screen.

a.caption: The old well
a.description: Dug before the houses around it, and the reason they stand here. The stone lid is new; the rope groove in the rim is not. Lean over and you can still hear water.

longest.caption: The old well and the quarrel over who may draw first in a dry summer
longest.description: Dug before the houses around it, and the reason they stand here. The stone lid is new; the rope groove in the rim is not. In dry summers the street drew water by turns, and the order was set every spring by lot. A family that missed its turn waited a whole day. Lean over and you can still hear water far below, though nobody has drawn a bucket from it in a long time, and the lid is only lifted once a year.

b.caption: Bench of the carters
b.description: Carters waited here for loads from the yard. The stone is worn into two hollows where they sat.
